caption: Creating /f does not give all locations. Block size is 128 MB; for 1024 MB there are 8 blocks. The client asks for b0 locations, writes b0 along DataNode 1 to 2 to 3; the ack returns 3 to 2 to 1, then DataNode 1 acks the client. The location exchange repeats for each block. File data never passes through the NameNode.

spec.aria: A client asks the NameNode to create a file, then asks for locations of block b0. It writes b0 along DataNode 1 to 2 to 3. The acknowledgement returns from DataNode 3 to 2 to 1, and DataNode 1 sends the final acknowledgement to the client.
